title: Bankspeak, Continued — analysis code and frozen design record
description:
Analysis code, test suite and complete frozen design record for an independent reconstruction of Moretti and Pestre's Bankspeak (2015) from primary World Bank documents, extended to fiscal 2024, together with a two-stage preregistered test of whether post-2022 LLM-associated vocabulary shows a World Bank discontinuity relative to an IMF Article IV comparator.

The confirmatory result is negative: no panel satisfies the preregistered decision rule. This archive exists so that conclusion can be checked rather than trusted. It contains the frozen inference engine, the validation battery, every decision and deviation record, the preregistration drafts and amendments, and the generators that produce every table and figure in the manuscript.

The corpus is not included, by licence rather than oversight. The 1,064 IMF Article IV staff reports are held under a written permission forbidding redistribution of documents or extracted text, so neither they nor the frame carrying their titles and URLs appear here. A separate evidence deposit lists every IMF-derived file by SHA-256 so that a researcher who lawfully obtains the same documents can verify byte identity before rerunning anything.

Stage-A preregistration: 10.17605/OSF.IO/5C9J8. Stage-B statistical analysis plan, externally timestamped before any reported outcome was computed: 10.5281/zenodo.22098259 (sha256 4aa122797f2db6ddd3e1dae5cb425958b231f02438f242bde174b25b20af2677).
notes: Code (src/, tools/, tests/, config/) is MIT licensed. Documentation (docs/) is licensed CC BY 4.0. No World Bank or IMF document text or bibliographic frame is included; the IMF corpus is held under a permission forbidding redistribution.
